title: [Master][All-e][FTE][SaaS] Last name of the employee relative is not editable when customized using “Profile (Role)”.
summary: The Last Name field is now visible and editable on the Employee Relatives page, allowing users to view and modify employee relative information.
key_points: Last Name field added to the Employee Relatives page in W1 and ES
The field already existed in the Employee Relative table but was not on the page
Small changes to the Employee Relative table in W1 and ES
UI tests added in W1, CZ, ES and RU to check the value can be edited and saved
